name.full: Snack Overflow: the meal poll bot

description.short: Weekly meal attendance and Friday lunch polls
description.full: Posts the weekly meal attendance poll and the Friday veg / non-veg poll, sends reminders to people who haven't voted, posts results, and shares the weekly menu. HR runs the commands in a 1:1 chat with the bot.

commands.title: use this chat
commands.description: HR: post polls, results and the menu in this chat.

commands.title: start weekly poll
commands.description: HR: post next week's attendance poll.

commands.title: start friday poll
commands.description: HR: post the Friday veg / non-veg poll.

commands.title: remind
commands.description: HR: remind people who haven't voted.

commands.title: close poll
commands.description: HR: close the poll and post results.

commands.title: set menu
commands.description: HR: paste the vendor's menu and preview it.
